data.long_meaning: Habibah is an Arabic name that means 'beloved' or 'dear one'. It is a term of endearment used to express love and affection. In Islamic tradition, it is believed to be a name that brings blessings and joy. The name Habibah carries the meaning “Beloved” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Habibah usually hope their child will grow to embody beloved and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islam, the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) was known to have used this term to address his beloved wife, Aisha.
data.etymology: Habibah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Beloved.”

in_arabic.name: حبيبة
